evidence.source: Contracts 210 and 211 applied to Development on 20 August 2026 by two fast-lane rollout runs: 32347550098 from exact main 46671e2cf452197953f36f0341fa572fbe5e074a took it to 210, and 32353837721 from exact main 71dbb9a5c596415ad94fb42df6e54757252b3393, the merge commit of #952, took it to 211. Both proved the pending migration additive by reading it, snapshotted, applied and confirmed. THIS RECORD IS WRITTEN BY HAND RATHER THAN BY THE FOLLOW-UP AUTOMATION, AND THE REASON MATTERS. The automation opened #955 for the same rollout, and #955 cannot merge: a pull request authored by github-actions[bot] does not trigger the repository's own CI workflows, so its required merge gate never runs. Its evidence field was also the bare string 'Development fast-lane rollout', which is true and unusable -- the record for contract 209 before it carried a measured paragraph, and a file whose whole job is to be checkable should not get quieter as it goes. The superseded #953, which recorded 210 from the earlier run, was closed rather than left open: Development moved 209 to 210 to 211 inside ninety minutes, and merging #953 after a 211 record would have dragged the committed number BACKWARDS to 210 while the database sat at 211. That is not cosmetic. The Production promotion gate reads this record and not the database, so an under-reported record silently refuses a promotion that is actually safe -- which is exactly how the first 209-to-211 rehearsal attempt failed, at the step named 'Refuse to make Production the first hosted environment to see Contract 211'. EVERYTHING BELOW IS AN INDEPENDENT READ-ONLY QUERY AGAINST DEVELOPMENT taken at 2026-08-20T09:54:01Z, separately from either run. The ledger holds 211 rows and NAMES 20260820090000 provider_deadline_watch_tier. THE THREE POLLING TIERS READ AS CONTRACT 211 INTENDS, on the one enabled target: idle cadence 1440, deadline watch 60 minutes reaching back 720, live cadence 10 reaching back 15. That is the whole point of the contract -- the long reach is on the hourly tier and the ten-minute tier is spent only on matches being played -- and it is why the same coverage costs 77 polls a matchweek instead of 252. predictor_internal.provider_target_awaits_deadline is installed, and the deadline_lead_minutes column default is 720, so a target created later inherits the watch rather than the gap. CONTRACT 209 SURVIVES UNDERNEATH: season_fixture_lifecycle_transitions still holds 0 rows and SportMonks token 10 still resolves to postponed. NOT ONE PLAYER-OWNED ROW MOVED, every figure matching the Contract-209 record: 24 auth users, 24 profiles, 34 entries, 64 season predictions, 756 match predictions, 5 leagues, 39 league members and 578 season fixtures. Cron remains 14 jobs. NEITHER ROLLOUT SPENT PROVIDER CREDIT.
